newsitem.title: UK: Fair demand at London tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Fair demand at London tea auction.

text.p: Fair demand was seen at the London tea auction but prices proved to be mixed, the official report said.

The few Kenyans on offer met good competition with brighter types about firm but mediums were as much as eight pence per kilo lower. Other East Africans eased four to six pence, except for selected lines which held steady.
The offshore sector saw Kenyas down two to five pence, while coloury central Africans were firm to dearer. Plainer descriptions however, lost ground.
The next auction will be held on Monday, June 30.
